tests.description: a numeric offset without minutes is invalid
a valid date-time-ext with an elective time-zone suffix
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: date-time-ext = date-time suffix, and time-zone = "[" critical-flag time-zone-name / time-numoffset "]". Syntactic validation only: the suffix is not checked against the IANA time zone database.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a numeric offset and a time-zone suffix
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: date-time-ext allows a time-zone suffix after an RFC 3339 date-time, including one with a numeric time-offset. Syntactic validation only: whether the offset agrees with the time zone name is not checked.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a critical time-zone suffix
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: critical-flag = ["!"]. The "!" is part of the time-zone syntax. Syntactic validation only: a critical suffix is not rejected here even if an application would later treat it as an error.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a suffix-tag
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: suffix-tag = "[" ["!"] suffix-key "=" suffix-values "]". Syntactic validation only: the key and value are not interpreted.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a numeric offset time-zone suffix
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: time-zone allows a time-numoffset in place of a time-zone-name. Syntactic validation only.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a critical suffix-tag
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: suffix-tag = "[" critical-flag suffix-key "=" suffix-values "]", so "!" is allowed on a suffix-tag as well as a time-zone. Syntactic validation only.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a time-zone suffix followed by suffix-tags
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: suffix = [time-zone] *suffix-tag, so a time-zone can be followed by any number of suffix-tags. Syntactic validation only.

tests.description: a valid date-time-ext with a 14 character time-zone-part
tests.comment: RFC 9557 section 4.1: time-zone-part = time-zone-initial *13time-zone-char, so a part can be up to 14 characters long. Syntactic validation only.
